mapper.sql: lot_no, product_code, qty, status, expiry_date, received_at, received_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_lot (lot_no, product_code, qty, status, expiry_date, received_at, received_by) VALUES (#{lotNo}, #{productCode}, #{qty}, #{status}, #{expiryDate}, #{receivedAt}, #{receivedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM stock_lot WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE status IN ('AVAILABLE', 'HOLD') ORDER BY lot_no
